# mapping_set_description: Mappings between ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A controls and NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 3 security requirements for protecting Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) in non-federal systems. SP 800-171 requirement identifiers follow the family.x.y pattern across 14 families (03.01 Access Control through 03.14 System and Information Integrity).
